m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY.md (if present), the g3 handoff, the #356 determinism test, the latent_power training path, and run_jobs. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions). Confirm torch is CPU-only so CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG is N/A. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + handoff + #356 test + training path loaded; handoff complete; torch 2.10.0+cpu confirmed (CUDA N/A)
postconditions.satisfied_by: Loaded CREW_CONTEXT, g3 handoff (complete), #356 test, training.py, run_jobs; torch 2.10.0+cpu CUDA N/A confirmed

m1-harness.title: Build throwaway measurement harness (no src/ change)
m1-harness.imperative: Write a throwaway measurement script under .agent-work/fn-decomposition-and-bitrepro/ that IMPORTS the #356 test setup (_run_plan / _build_jobs / _load_weights / _max_weight_diff) and runs the bounded job set (2 recent_history quali modules, train_years=[2022,2023], eval_year=2024, max_rounds_per_year=1, ~2 epochs) through run_jobs at n_workers=1 (in-process so determinism flags apply). It must: (1) for each condition run training TWICE into separate temp trees, (2) compute max-abs state_dict drift between the two runs and per-run wall-time, (3) support conditions: baseline, deterministic-strict (use_deterministic_algorithms(True)+set_num_threads(1)), and deterministic-warn (warn_only=True, logging nondeterministic ops). Capture the exact op+error if strict RAISES. Do NOT modify any src/ file. Verify the script imports cleanly.

postconditions.statement: measurement script exists and imports cleanly (no src/ change)

check.command: py -c "import ast,pathlib; ast.parse(pathlib.Path('.agent-work/fn-decomposition-and-bitrepro/bitrepro_spike.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); print('PARSE-OK')" && py -m pip show torch >NUL 2>&1 && echo HARNESS-OK

payload.cmd: py -c "import ast,pathlib; ast.parse(pathlib.Path('.agent-work/fn-decomposition-and-bitrepro/bitrepro_spike.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); print('PARSE-OK')" && py -m pip show torch >NUL 2>&1 && echo HARNESS-OK

m2-measure.title: Run measurements (>=2 runs per condition); capture drift + wall-time
m2-measure.imperative: Run the measurement harness end to end. For each condition record run-to-run max-abs weight drift and per-run wall-time. If use_deterministic_algorithms(True) raises, capture the exact op + error message as a key finding; then measure with warn_only=True and log the nondeterministic ops. Write raw numbers to a JSON artifact under .agent-work for reproducibility.

postconditions.statement: harness runs to completion and emits a results JSON + printed table (exit 0)

constraints: fair comparison: vary only determinism knobs

m3-report.title: Write bitrepro report with measurements table + GO/NO-GO
m3-report.imperative: Write .agent-work/fn-decomposition-and-bitrepro/bitrepro-report.md: methodology, harness/config used, measurements table (drift + wall-time per condition, >=2 runs each), which ops (if any) lack deterministic impls (exact op + error), and a clear GO/NO-GO recommendation against the criterion (GO iff deterministic drift < 1e-6 at < 2x baseline wall-time without production change beyond a contained set-flags call). Include re-run instructions.

preconditions.satisfied_by: m2-measure complete; canonical results JSON written

postconditions.statement: report exists with measurements table and an explicit GO/NO-GO line
